verdict.rationale: Meltano supports building custom connectors via the Meltano SDK (Singer taps/targets) for long-tail APIs, evidenced by docs on building your own connector, plugin architecture, and a community testimonial of developing a custom tap with SDK support described as 'top class.' missing for 10: no dedicated low-code builder UI evidence, no detailed SDK walkthrough or scaffolding command example in the pack, and no independent benchmark of connector build effort beyond one anecdote.
